_rationale: Ages 55-64: identical to fixed-growth-no-tax (no income yet). path[n] = 185000 * 1.05^n + 315000. At age 65 (index 10): path ≈ 616345.51, then pension adds 10k/yr reducing net spending to 5k. From age 65 balance grows faster. Values computed iteratively: balance_new = (balance - 15000 + income) * 1.05. 100% probability — balance always positive.
